items.text:
NON-UNION 

$2,000/DAY — SEEKING REAL ADVENTURERS WHO CAN ACT

Sliding down a grassy hill like you're sledding on snow. Likely wire-assisted, so a rig drags you down. The rig does the work — you sell the ride.

Ages 18–35, all genders and ethnicities. Comfortable in a harness. 

1–2 days in BC, Canada between Sept 28 – Oct 3. Non-union. $500/day travel, flights and hotel covered. Client is Nike.

Skiers, snowboarders, parkour athletes, climbers, aerialists, bikers, skaters — this is you.

Full details and submissions:

https://www.stuntlisting.com/jobs/152

Deadline Tuesday at 4:00 pm pst. — Brady Romberg, Casting

topComments.text: Already in Vancouver,  ex professional athlete.

All physical...sport driven....that is but a fraction of adventuring.....I will offer you to step on the wild side....as the horizon comes into view....as the dawn of perception reveals itself. The psycho spiritual experience reveals itself.

🎞️ **For collectors and cinephiles: a question worth arguing about.**

Before we call a film a “classic”, it has to survive. Then it has to be found, preserved, restored, shown, written about, taught, distributed — and remembered.

The Library of Congress estimates that around **70% of American silent feature films from 1912–1929 are completely lost**. And even when films survive, the canon keeps shifting: *Jeanne Dielman* moved from 36th place in the 2012 *Sight and Sound* critics’ poll to **No. 1 in 2022**.

So here’s the real question:

**Which film do you think deserves to be rediscovered, preserved, or brought back into the conversation?**

Not necessarily the most famous one.
Not the most valuable disc on the shelf.
The one whose disappearance would make film history poorer.

I’ve put together a long-form dossier on **film canon, preservation, archives, collectors, restoration, criticism and rediscovery**:

👉 [https://acasadocolecionador.com/blog/politica-do-canone-cinema-film-canon-preservacao](https://acasadocolecionador.com/blog/politica-do-canone-cinema-film-canon-preservacao)

💬 Drop one overlooked title in the comments — and tell us why it matters.
Someone in the group may discover it because of you.

sharedPost.text:
🎬 WHO DECIDES WHICH FILMS MAKE HISTORY — AND WHICH ONES DISAPPEAR?

We often talk about the greatest films ever made as though cinema history arrived intact, waiting for critics to rank it.

It didn’t.

In the United States alone, the Library of Congress estimates that 70% of American silent feature films made between 1912 and 1929 are completely lost. Of almost 11,000 titles documented, only about 3,300 are known to survive in some form. Archives, studios, libraries — and private collectors — have all played a part in determining what remains available to us today.

And survival is only the first battle.

A film can physically exist and still become almost invisible. It has to be catalogued, preserved, restored, screened, subtitled, distributed, written about, taught, collected and rediscovered.

That raises a fascinating question:

Are the films we call “canonical” simply the greatest films — or are they also the films that had the best chance of surviving and circulating?

Think of Metropolis. Detour. Vertigo. The Red Shoes. The Passion of Joan of Arc. Jeanne Dielman. Touki bouki. T-Men. Gun Crazy.

Each reached us through a different chain of preservation, access and rediscovery.

And even the canon itself is not fixed.

In the 2012 Sight and Sound critics’ poll, Chantal Akerman’s Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles ranked 36th. In 2022, with more than 1,600 critics, academics, curators, archivists, programmers and writers taking part, it rose to No. 1.

The film had not changed.

The culture looking at it had.

Meanwhile, preservation organisations continue to bring films back into circulation. The Film Foundation says it has helped restore more than 1,100 films, while its World Cinema Project has restored and shared 72 films from 34 countries with global audiences.

That is why this new Cinematheque dossier is not another “100 films you must see before you die” list.

It asks a much more interesting question:

Before we decide which films are the greatest, shouldn’t we ask which films were actually given the chance to survive?

Inside the article: lost cinema, nitrate, restoration, archives, collectors, critics, universities, festivals, home video, streaming, algorithms, rediscovery — and the invisible chain of decisions that turns a film into cultural memory.

🎞️ Read the full dossier:
https://acasadocolecionador.com/blog/politica-do-canone-cinema-film-canon-preservacao

And now a question for serious film lovers and collectors:

If you could guarantee the survival of ONE film for audiences 100 years from now, which one would you choose?

Not necessarily the most famous.
Not the most expensive edition on your shelf.
Not the film everyone already knows.

Choose the film whose disappearance would make cinema history poorer.

Tell us the title — and tell us why.

Someone reading your comment may discover it for the first time.

🎬 A Casa do Colecionador — Cinematheque

🎬 ISO: COSTUME DESIGNER — LOW-BUDGET INDEPENDENT FILM 👗🎥

I’m looking for a Costume Designer to join a low-budget independent film production in Los Angeles. 🌴

Looking for someone who can help develop the characters’ wardrobe and overall visual style, source/organize costumes, and work with the director to achieve the look of the film. 🎨👔

Looking for:
✨ Costume design experience preferred, but emerging designers are welcome
🧵 Creative and resourceful with a low-budget approach
🤝 Able to collaborate with a small independent production team
📍 Must be based in Los Angeles / LA area

This is a small independent production, so I’m especially interested in people who enjoy creative problem-solving and building a strong visual style with limited resources. 🎭

If interested, please DM me with your portfolio/previous work, Instagram, or website and a brief introduction. 📩

items.text:
**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

🎬 WHAT CAN HAPPEN WHEN YOU GET TWO DAYS IN THE ROOM WITH A TV DRAMA DIRECTOR?

We’re delighted to welcome experienced TV Drama Director Suri Krishnamma to Manchester for a special two-day Screen Acting Intensive.

With directing credits including Waking The Dead, Blue Murder, Cold Blood, Coronation Street, Emmerdale and Casualty, Suri brings a wealth of television experience into the room.

Across the weekend, you’ll have the opportunity to:

🎬 Work practically with Suri on screen material

🎥 Explore different choices and see how they translate on camera

🔄 Receive direction, make adjustments and go again

💬 Get individual feedback focused on your work

The two-day format allows the work to unfold across the weekend—exploring the material, responding to direction and returning to it with fresh discoveries.

This is a rare opportunity to spend two focused days working with an experienced television director in a very small group.

📅 3 & 4 October
⏰ 10am–6pm on both days
📍 Central Manchester

🎬 WHAT CAN HAPPEN WHEN YOU GET TWO DAYS IN THE ROOM WITH A TV DRAMA DIRECTOR?

We’re delighted to welcome experienced TV Drama Director Suri Krishnamma to Manchester for a special two-day Screen Acting Intensive.

With directing credits including Waking The Dead, Blue Murder, Cold Blood, Coronation Street, Emmerdale and Casualty, Suri brings a wealth of television experience into the room.

Across the weekend, you’ll have the opportunity to:

🎬 Work practically with Suri on screen material

🎥 Explore different choices and see how they translate on camera

🔄 Receive direction, make adjustments and go again

💬 Get individual feedback focused on your work

The two-day format allows the work to unfold across the weekend—exploring the material, responding to direction and returning to it with fresh discoveries.

This is a rare opportunity to spend two focused days working with an experienced television director in a very small group.

📅 3 & 4 October
⏰ 10am–6pm on both days
📍 Central Manchester
🎟 £220 | Members £198

Places are deliberately limited to keep the group small.

A RADICAL RETELLING OF MACBETH

Behind the mask,
Between the lines, 
Beneath the reputation...

LADY M is a one-woman journey into the mind of Shakespeare's "fiend-like queen".

When a letter arrives from her husband promising a life of greatness, Lady M believes she’s found the answer to all her problems. But with murder, men, and her own mind to contend with, her future begins to unravel, and the present becomes imprisoned in a past that refuses to die.

Created by The Working Action Group, this psychological portrait of Lady Macbeth combines classical text with bold new writing, outrageous humour, and playful physical storytelling,
and dares to shed new light on Shakespeare's darkest tragedy.

Join us this October
and go beyond the story
the world has heard before. 

PLAYHOUSE EAST 
14-18 OCTOBER

https://www.tickettailor.com/events/playhouseeast/2357359

**CASTING CALL EXPERIMENTAL FICTION SHORT DRAMA, COPENHAGEN (UNPAID)**

We are looking for native English-speaking actors for an upcoming experimental fiction project set in Copenhagen in early October. The project is being produced in collaboration with Minehubs Studios.

The production is unpaid, but travel expenses related to the shoot will be covered, and meals and refreshments will be provided during filming.

We are currently casting the following roles:

Andrew (Male), 40–60

The VP of his father’s company. He will do almost anything to earn his father’s recognition.

Mr. Ashford / Lawyer (Male), 40–70

A clever man who is never taking anyone’s side. He never reveals more than absolutely necessary.

Sarah (Female), 40–60

Determined to make amends for the terrible things her father has done. However, she finds herself facing the consequences on her own.

Leona (Female), 60–70

She has spent her entire life waiting for the chance to take revenge on Robert by claiming the entire inheritance, and has little concern for the people who have helped him.

To apply, please send:

• A recent and recognizable photo of yourself

• Your CV and/or details of any previous acting experience, if available

• Which role you would like to be considered for

Please send applications to js@minehubsstudios.com

We look forward to hearing from you.

Wir öffnen dafür nur noch wenige Plätze für unseren POLIZEI-AUFBAU-WORKSHOP.

Und das ist definitiv kein klassischer Schauspielworkshop. 😉

Hier geht’s um das, was man auf der Kamera sehen muss: authentisches Verhalten, sichere Abläufe und glaubwürdiges Agieren in realitätsnahen Einsatzsituationen.

🎬 Realistische Einsatzszenarien
👮 Personenkontrollen, Durchsuchungen & Fesselungstechniken
🚔 Personentransport & Verbringen ins Einsatzfahrzeug
🥋 Selbstverteidigung & Umgang mit aggressiven Personen
🔫 Professionelles Waffenhandling
🎯 Betreutes Schießtraining auf einer Schießanlage
💥 Training unter Stress & situatives/taktisches Agieren

Tag 2 steht komplett im Zeichen des Schießtrainings – professionell angeleitet und in kleinen Trainingsgruppen.

📍 01.11.2026 – Dachau
📍 02.11.2026 – Schießanlage Oberschleißheim

⚠️ WICHTIG: Das ist ein AUFBAU-Workshop.

Er richtet sich an Teilnehmer, die bereits unseren Basis-Workshop absolviert haben oder entsprechende berufliche bzw. langjährige praktische Erfahrung mitbringen.

Zum Beispiel aus:
👮 Polizei
🪖 Bundeswehr
⚖️ Justiz
🛡️ Sicherheitsdienst
🎬 oder durch umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Polizeirollen vor der Kamera

Wir schauen uns jede Anmeldung individuell an und klären vorab, ob dein Erfahrungsstand für den Aufbau-Workshop passt.

Denn genau das macht den Unterschied:
Wir wollen nicht einfach möglichst viele Teilnehmer – wir wollen, dass die richtigen Leute miteinander trainieren können 🔥.

📩 Infos, Preis & Anmeldung:
Schreibt uns an info@komparse.tv

Wenn du also schon Erfahrung mitbringst und Polizeirollen vor der Kamera auf das nächste Level bringen willst:
👉 Meld dich jetzt.

Die Plätze sind bewusst begrenzt – und wenn sie voll sind, sind sie voll 👮‍♂️🔥🎬😜!

Wir sehen uns in Dachau & Oberschleißheim! ❤️‍🔥

Für ein schwedisches Spielfilm-Projekt an der Filmakademie Stockholm suchen wir Besetzungen für zwei Rollen. Der Dreh findet am **Dienstag, den 22. September** in Wien statt.

**Gesuchte Rollen**
* **Kellner / Kellnerin** (männlich oder weiblich)
   * **Rollenart:** Kleindarsteller / Statist
   * **Drehzeit:** Dienstag, 22. Sept. – vormittags
* **Dr. Aichhorn** (männlich, ab 50 Jahren)
   * **Rollenart:** Sprechrolle (Kleindarsteller)
   * **Drehzeit:** Dienstag, 22. Sept. – nachmittags (ca. 16:30 – 19:00 Uhr)

Da es sich um eine unabhängige studentische Produktion ohne Budget handelt, können die Rollen leider nicht vergütet werden.

Wir bieten selbstverständlich einen Credit im Abspann, sowie Verpflegung am Set.

Bei Interesse senden Sie bitte ein aktuelles Foto (und ggf. Kontaktdaten) unter Angabe der gewünschten Rolle an **hello@felixgreisinger.com**.

See you at Selfcast! 📸

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🛑  CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na DM krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

🎬 Gdańsk - szukamy aktorek do pełnometrażowego filmu Obłęd - film fabularny (najlepiej z okolic Trójmiasta)

- sekretarka firmy logistycznej ( dwa zdania ) 
- pani sprzedająca owoce ( jedno zdanie ) 

Film realizowany jest bez budżetu ale oferujemy zwrot za dojazd na plan i wynagrodzenie do dogadania. 

W obsadzie mamy 3 znane nazwiska 
Termin realizacji 24 i 25 września w zależności jaka rola. 

Chętne Panie zapraszamy na priv 
Miła atmosfera super załoga , bez stresu czy spiny czasowej - tylko tworzy klimat. 

Wojciech Miga

KTO CHĘTNY NA ZAJĘCIA AKTORSKIE?!

Siemano liptoniary!

Szukam jeszcze około 8 osób chętnych na zajęcia aktorskie(w Poznaniu) ponieważ potrzebujemy jeszcze kilku osób żeby otworzyć grupę!!

Jeśli zawsze chciałyście spróbować swoich sił w aktorstwie albo po prostu macie ochotę nauczyć się czegoś nowego to mega zachęcam do dołączenia.

Nie trzeba mieć doświadczenia liczą się chęci i dobra zabawa.

Ta grupa będzie dla osób w wieku 13–19 lat,ale jeśli masz 9–10 lat to też jak najbardziej jesteś mile widziana / mile widziany!!Dla młodszych dzieci będzie po prostu osobna grupa wiekowa.

Potrzebujemy jezcze około 8 osób żeby ruszyć z grupą więc jeśli masz ochotę spróbować swoich sił w aktorstwie to pisz(powiem co mniej wiecej ale ja ich nie tworzę)!!(naprawde moze byc ciekawie i super  )

🎬 **CASTING CALL - VERMONT FEATURE FILM - PAID** 🎬

I’m a Vermont-based casting director currently casting *Overview*, a paid feature film written and directed by John Schlag of Infinovation Films. We’re looking for actors for several roles!

**Mollie:** Female | Any Ethnicity | Playing Age: **15** | Lead
Teenage heroine who is bright, inquisitive, energetic, tenacious, and somewhat athletic. **Prefer 18+ actors who can convincingly play 15, but open to younger actors.**

**Finn:** Male | Mid-East-Indian, Hispanic, Asian, or African-American | Playing Age: **17** | Supporting
Mollie’s friendly, tech-savvy schoolmate who has a crush on her. **Prefer 18+ actors who can convincingly play 17, but open to younger actors.**

**Jess:** Female | African-American | Playing Age: **40s** | Supporting
An astronaut working from ground control who develops a mentoring relationship with Mollie.

**Vivian:** Female | Mid-East-Indian, Hispanic, Asian, or African-American | Playing Age: **40s–50s** | Supporting
A capable NASA administrator and former astronaut candidate.

**Additional Roles Any Ethnicity: Liz (40s–50s), Zoë (30s Australian), Congresswoman (50s+), Aide (20s), Kenneth (20s), and Receptionist (20s). **

*Overview* is a hopeful, family-friendly sci-fi story about a teenage girl who connects strange events happening on Earth to a rogue asteroid and sets out to convince the adults around her to work together on a plan that just might save humanity.

📍 **Filming:** Colchester, Vermont, right off Exit 16
📅 **Production:** Mid-October 2026
💰 **PAID** | SAG-AFTRA Ultra Low Budget Project Agreement
🎭 **SAG-AFTRA membership is not required to submit.**

To be considered, complete the audition form with your headshot, resume, and either a reel or self-tape. No reel? You can submit a self-tape of a monologue of your choosing, no more than two minutes.

👉 **AUDITION FORM:**
[https://forms.gle/rtfa2NtWNzs8wsPx5](https://forms.gle/rtfa2NtWNzs8wsPx5)

Please share with any actors who might be interested!

**HOW TO SUBMIT:**
Please fill out the following form, further information about shoot dates and rates are noted at the top of the form. NO emailed or DM submissions will be considered.

https://forms.gle/GDr9f83ZdqAiDNvr6

Details:

We are casting **Three (3) hero roles plus office background talent** for a commercial campaign filming in the Toronto/GTA.

All hero roles are non-speaking and performance-driven. We are looking for natural, contemporary professionals who feel authentic in a premium corporate office environment.

Talent should have strong screen presence and be comfortable with subtle, natural performance. We are looking for real, believable reactions and behaviour rather than overly expressive commercial acting.

All ethnicities encouraged.

**HERO CLIENT**

**Gender:** Male
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A confident, contemporary business professional arriving for an important meeting. Polished and credible, but approachable and natural. Strong screen presence with the ability to communicate subtle reactions through expression and body language.

**Gender:** Female
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A sophisticated, perceptive professional touring a potential new office space. Confident and self-assured, with strong screen presence. The performance is subtle and observational, with much of the character's impression communicated through small reactions and body language.

**Gender:** Female
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A polished, warm and confident commercial leasing professional leading a prospective tenant through an office tour. Professional and composed while still feeling approachable, natural and authentic.

**OFFICE BACKGROUND TALENT**

**Gender:** All
**Playing Age:** 25-55
**Role:** Background

A diverse mix of contemporary office professionals to create a natural, active workplace environment throughout the campaign.

We are looking for people who feel credible in a modern corporate setting across a range of roles and levels of seniority. Polished and professional, but with personality and individuality. Avoid an overly uniform or traditional "corporate stock" look.

Background talent should be comfortable performing natural workplace actions such as moving through the office, working at desks, attending meetings and interacting casually with colleagues.
**OVERALL CASTING DIRECTION**

Across all roles, we are looking for:

● Natural, believable performers

● Contemporary professional appearance

● Interesting, authentic faces

● Diverse representation across the cast

● Subtle and restrained performance

● Comfortable interacting naturally with products and their environment

● No dialogue required

📅 13 November–24 December

📅 19 November–24 December
🎭 Puss

Dates listed are performance dates. Rehearsals usually take place a few days before each tour begins, so applicants must also be available beforehand. Exact rehearsal dates will be confirmed.

These are professional, two-actor touring productions, bringing theatre to community venues, including care homes, nursing homes and residential schemes.

All roles require a strong singing voice. We’re looking for friendly, reliable and versatile actors who enjoy working in a small team and interacting closely with audiences.

Being based in the relevant tour area is an advantage, but not essential.

🎭 Non-drivers: £520

⛽ Tour fuel costs are paid by the company, in addition to your weekly fee.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to submit a self-tape, followed by an informal Zoom call.

🎬 ATLANTA CASTING CALL
BABY NEEDED FOR SHORT FILM

We are still looking for our Baby Max for At Least You’re Alive, a SAG Micro-Budget, grant-winning short film shooting in the Fayetteville area October 10

BABY MAX

• Any gender

• 6-10 months old

• Caucasian/white (to portray the child of our already-cast parents)

• $150/day

• Background role / no dialogue

• Parent or guardian must remain on set at all times

 CLC will be on set 

Baby Max is needed for only two - three very brief, non-hazardous shots. Baby will be safely secured in an infant carrier/car seat. No driving with baby in the vehicle.

This is a deeply personal film about a new mother struggling with postpartum PTSD and panic disorder following a traumatic emergency C-section. 

We have a wonderful professional cast and crew coming together for this project, and we would love to find a local family interested in joining us.

The production is SAG Micro-Budget and will comply with applicable Georgia requirements for infant performers.

If interested, please DM me with:

• Baby’s name and current age

• A recent photo

• Parent/guardian name

• Your general Atlanta-area location

• Availability October 10

Please share or tag an Atlanta parent who might have the perfect Baby Max! ❤️

Breakdown is also posted on Actors Access

Film Title At Least You're Alive

We’re looking for someone based in a **major German city** to conduct street interviews for Lio.

You’ll approach people, ask about their **smoking/vaping habits**, let them try Lio, and capture their reactions. Lio mimics the familiar sensation and ritual of smoking/vaping without nicotine, smoke, or vapor, helping people quit while keeping the habit.

**€50/hour — approx. 3 hours per session.**

We’ll send you the product beforehand.

If the content performs well, we’d love to make this a **long-term collaboration**.

Kollektiv is a booking, payment and management platform built for Berlin’s independent creative scene—from DJs and tattoo artists to photographers, designers, performers and collectives.

With one public link, people can discover your work, book services or events and pay without creating an account. Creators manage bookings, income, collaborator splits, guest lists, secret locations and German-compliant invoices from one simple dashboard.

Built in Berlin. Made for the scene. 🖤💚

Discover Kollektiv:
[https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app](https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app/)

#Kollektiv #BerlinCreatives #IndependentArtists #CreatorEconomy

**PROJEKT UTOPIA's next Immersion Lab is coming up soon!**
**5-9 October 2026 | Artsadmin, London**

IMMERSION LAB by PROJEKT UTOPIA returns for its second edition with a week-long programme exploring embodied approaches to performance-making.

Across five days, five different artists will lead workshops on physical practice to generate ideas, dramaturgy and scenic material. Workshops will draw on physical improvisation, movement scores, choreographic tools, ensemble composition, task-based performance and other embodied approaches to devising.

This is an exciting chance to supercharge your practice, connect with a vibrant community of artists, and make work that feels urgent, alive and unapologetically relevant.

**When is it?**

Workshops are taking place 5–9 October 2026, 10am–5pm.

**Who is it for?**

Performers, choreographers, movement artists, directors, devisers and interdisciplinary makers interested in expanding their practice through experimentation and exchange.

https://www.artsadmin.co.uk/events/immersion-lab-2-generating-performance-through-the-body/

items.text:
🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie. Od początku wchodzi w mocny konflikt z Husarem, dlatego ta rola może stanowić spore wyzwanie. 

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

2️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Rola tej postaci na pewno jest wyzywaniem ze względu na mocny konflik z Mrozem na tle rasowym. 

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

Nagrania potrwają od jednego do dwóch dni. 

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ? (ZGŁOSZENIA DO 01.10)

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI! 👇 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BIJgru47_mymjk5LL49I-qX80mRdcU3D_BOEfu7MWLc/edit?usp=sharing

🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie. Od początku wchodzi w mocny konflikt z Husarem, dlatego ta rola może stanowić spore wyzwanie. 

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

2️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Rola tej postaci na pewno jest wyzywaniem ze względu na mocny konflik z Mrozem na tle rasowym. 

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

Nagrania potrwają od jednego do dwóch dni. 

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ? (ZGŁOSZENIA DO 01.10)

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI! 👇 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BIJgru47_mymjk5LL49I-qX80mRdcU3D_BOEfu7MWLc/edit?usp=sharing

**NORWEGIAN AURA CASTING AUDITIONS**
**NON-UNION**

Norwegian Cruise Line is currently seeking **Production Dancers, Singers, Specialty Vocalists, and Aerialists** for original mainstage productions debuting aboard the newest vessel, the Norwegian AURA.

The AURA will feature a brand-new concert/Las Vegas residency-style production centered around the musical legacy of Whitney Houston, following in the footsteps of *Revolution: A Celebration of Prince* aboard Norwegian AQUA and *Elton: A Celebration of Elton John* aboard Norwegian LUNA. Cast members may also participate in and/or cover other entertainment offerings including Welcome Aboard Shows, nightclub events, parties, and other experiences.

PRODUCTION DANCERS — LOS ANGELES

**Saturday, September 19, 2026**
**OPEN CALL — NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**Mihran K. Studios**
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502

Sign-in: **9:30 AM**
Audition begins: **10:00 AM**

Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive. **Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.**

Female-identifying performers should be prepared to dance in both **heels and flats**. Male-identifying dancers should bring **sneakers and jazz shoes**. Please bring a hard copy headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combinations.

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile dancers with a strong technical foundation and training in a wide range of styles spanning commercial jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, and more. The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. Strong performance quality, audience engagement, and storytelling are essential. Tumbling/acro is a plus, and certain dancers will be trained in various aerial skills during the rehearsal process. **All ethnicities. Singing is not required. Must be 18+.**

**DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard**

**Full Los Angeles audition information:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

SINGERS & SPECIALTY VOCALISTS — LOS ANGELES

**Sunday, September 20, 2026**
**BY APPOINTMENT ONLY **

Seeking Production Singers and Specialty Vocalists. Specialty Vocalists should be seasoned vocalist entertainers with strong pop, gospel and R&B backgrounds, while Production Singers should be charismatic performers with strong contemporary pop, rock and R&B skills, tight harmonies, and the ability to move or dance well.

**Specialty Vocalists: $1,730/week ($7,500/month)**
**Singers: $1,200/week ($5,200/month)**

To be considered for an appointment, submit through Breakdown Services, Actors Access, or the audition link below. Selected applicants will receive audition location, time, and additional details by email.

**Full Los Angeles audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

AERIALISTS — LAS VEGAS

**Tuesday, September 22, 2026**
**BY INVITATION ONLY **

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile gymnasts/acrobats and aerial artists with expertise in skills including **Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro/tumbling**. Strong upper-body strength and physical presence are required. Dance training and an understanding of body lines and positions are a major plus. The ability to engage an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is essential.

**Aerialists: $1,350/week ($5,850/month) onboard**

Pre-registration is required. To be considered for an appointment, submit through the link below. Selected applicants will receive the audition location, time, and additional details by email. **Male and female identifying. All ethnicities. Must be 18+.**

**Full Las Vegas audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html)

When Angela learns that her brother, Marvin, who attends a PWI, has developed a mindset of self-hatred that manifests itself as zombieism, she must figure out how to reignite his love for black culture before it’s too late.

Director: Olivia L. Stallworth 

Producer: Mercy Kinsey 

Casting Director: Kyra Muller 

CONTACT: 

If you are interested please send over your name, headshot and preferred role to mybrothermarvincasts@gmail.com

Non-Union - Unpaid

Bright Star Touring Theatre, the nation’s largest provider of theatre for youth audiences, is currently seeking an Indigenous actor for our 2-person national tour. We are accepting performers of all gender identities for a tour that includes the shows: “Peter Pan”, “Cherokee Tales”, and “The Pirate of Bully Bay”.

This is a paid opportunity, including a compensated rehearsal period, with travel and lodging provided for the duration of the contract. Rehearsal begins in Raleigh, NC on October 4th, and the tour runs through November 24th. Compensation is set at $500/week, including the lodging and tour vehicle.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

Hi everyone 👋

Vlyt Art Acting is announcing the first intake of the Vlyt Art Acting Lab, starting in Pretoria this October.

This is not a casting call. It is acting training.

The Lab is an 8-week, zero-to-performance practical acting programme for aspiring actors, people who are new to acting, or actors returning to the practice.

The training follows the structure of contemporary international acting training — comparable to scene study and acting foundation classes in the US, UK, Russia and Europe.

For this first intake, we’ll be working with The Fraudsters, an English adaptation based on David Petrus du Toit’s 1892 South African comedy Di Bedrieërs.

We’ll work practically with text, character, physical behaviour, scene work, relationships, ensemble and rehearsal, developing the material towards performance.

📅 19 October – 7 December 2026
📍 Pretoria
🎭 Mondays & Wednesdays, 09:00–12:00
👥 Limited places available

https://linktr.ee/vlytartacting

sharedPost.text:
THE FRAUDSTERS

The first performance project of the Vlyt Art Acting Lab is an English adaptation of D.P. du Toit’s 1892 one-act comedy, Di Bedriegers.

Our English version is called The Fraudsters.

Five men are supposed to report for military service during the border war.

But they don’t want to go.

So they each visit the doctor with a different excuse: a stiff leg, blindness, deafness, a terrible stutter, and poverty with too many children.

They’re all trying to trick the doctor into giving them exemption certificates.

But when they return to collect their certificates, they meet the doctor’s beautiful daughter — and their carefully constructed fraud begins to fall apart.

Physical comedy. Deception. Romantic rivalry. High stakes.

And, most importantly, characters to play.

For us, the story is the starting point for the acting work. We learn by playing, exploring characters, working with text and developing the piece together.

If The Fraudsters sounds like something you’d like to play, applications for the first Vlyt Art Acting Lab are now open.

Pretoria
October–December 2026
8 weeks

Application in bio.

Vlyt Art Acting
Through diligence, art blooms.

#vlytartacting #actingclass #pretoria

items.text:
**Cape Town**

Urgently looking for background talent/extras for a church scene for an upcoming graduation film, *Skoenmaker se Kind. *

The film is set in the Karoo and follows two teenage boys who begin a secret romance away from the watchful eyes of their staunch religious community, as they come of age and try to imagine a future.

The film is both an assigned and passion project for a group of final year film students who are looking to create something high quality, professional, and impactful, with limited resources. 

Details:
* Shoot in Rondebosch (exact location will be shared once you are confirmed)
* Monday and Tuesday (21 & 22 September), 08:00 - 13h00.
* It is entirely voluntary and will thus, regrettably, be unpaid. Your attendance would do wonders in making this special story by a group of final year UCT students come to life.
* Light catering will be provided.

Please email skoenmakersekindfilm@gmail.com, if interested and keen

Details:
* Shoot in Rondebosch (exact location will be shared once you are confirmed)
* Monday and Tuesday (21 & 22 September), 08:00 - 13h00.
* It is entirely voluntary and will thus, regrettably, be unpaid. Your attendance would do wonders in making this special story by a group of final year UCT students come to life.
* Light catering will be provided.

Please email skoenmakersekindfilm@gmail.com, if interested and keen

CASTING CALL: 📢📢📢
SELF-TAPES

*LAST DAY TO UPLOAD SELF-TAPES IS SEPTEMBER 24th*

Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short.

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.

CASTING: Independent Action-Horror Short (PAID — Negotiable) (Denver/Englewood Area)
Casting two roles for ENTER DRAGONEVSKI, a dark, stylized action-horror short as the first in a film series (Mortal Kombat vibes):

LEAD COMBATANT/SERAPHINA (Ages 18–35): One actress plays every female antagonist—5 distinct squad members and a commander named Seraphina. Huge showcase for range.

SUPPORTING COMBATANT (Any Gender, 18–40): A recurring squad partner who enters the fights, throws down, and sells over-the-top fatalities.

REQUIREMENTS: No high-level stunt experience needed! Just high energy, physical commitment, and genuine excitement for screen fighting/genre work.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION & EXPECTATIONS:

Vibe: A personal, ultra-low-budget indie project shot in a studio apartment. Small crew, raw energy, and direct collaboration.

Physical Expectations: Fun, high-intensity physical movement, floor work, taking safe falls/mats, and dramatic death/fatality reactions.

What’s Provided: Negotiable stipend, basic food/snacks/drinks on set, IMDb credit, and fight scene video footage for your reel once edited.

TIMELINE:

Submissions: Open now through 9/24

Auditions: Quick self-tapes

Shoot Window: 9/25 – 9/27 (Englewood area)

DM me with a headshot or photo and a quick note on your background/interest!

💃 Female Dancers Wanted — with Animation & Choreography Skills — 5-Star Resort Hotel, China ✨

SEGRACE Entertainment is looking for a female performer who combines dance, animation, and choreography skills — one versatile artist, not three separate roles — to join the entertainment team at a 5-star hotel and resort in China. We want a creative artist passionate about building new shows, not just performing them.

Requirements
• A single performer skilled in dance, animation, and choreography (all three)
• Strong stage presence, creative, collaborative, reliable
• Height: 168+

The role
• Location: 5-star hotel & resort, China
• Contract: 1 year, stable contract
• Schedule: 6 days/week, 1 day off
• 7–8 daytime performances daily across hotel areas and venues — animation, guest interaction, greetings, parades, and dance
• Arrival date around Mid October

Daily performance schedule
🏨 Lobby shows: 12:30–12:45 · 13:00–13:15 · 13:30–13:45
☀️ Outdoor parade: 16:15–16:45
✨ Evening show (outdoor stage): 20:00–20:45 — 8 numbers total, each artist performing different pieces

What we cover
✈️ Return international flight + visa expenses covered
🏠 Dorm/apartment accommodation — private bathroom, shower, washing machine, refrigerator
🍽️ daily meals in the staff canteen

📹 How to apply: 
This is a video-based selection. We reply only to applicants who send their materials. DMs without photos and videos won't receive a response — please include everything below.

Contact dojoshaolin on WeChat or Telegram with:
• A short intro (name, current location)
• Professional photos
• Recent performance video(s) — required
• Your promotional material / EPK
• Your salary quotation (please include your expected monthly fee)
📩 WeChat / Telegram: dojoshaolin

**CASTING CALL – N.E.S.T. PROJECT**

@everyone

💢CASTING CALL 💢
Its that time again....

Auditions (self tapes) are now open for 'Benji jnr' and "Benji's mum". 

The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces. 

The film is the second film of Tori Hughes, who's first film 'The Aftermath' is an award winning film and currently doing the festival circuit. 

See slides for roles, dates and details.

Please be aware that roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing and so this may change given budget. Film will be entered into the festival circuit and is built to raise awareness of themes involved. 

Please message myself, Claire Ward   or Sarah Elizabeth if you wish to self tape. We look forward to watching!

Deadline is 20th September.

**FINAL WEEKS OF CASTING!! BIG PERSONALITIES WANTED FOR A NEW PRISON ESCAPE COMPETITION SERIES**

Do you have what it takes to survive the pressure, outsmart the competition, endure the relentless realities of prison life, and ultimately find a way out?

An exciting new reality competition series is searching nationwide for bold, skilled, and charismatic individuals ready to test their limits in a one-of-a-kind social and survival experiment.

Contestants will live, compete, and survive inside a real decommissioned prison that has been transformed for this extraordinary challenge. Cut off from the comforts of everyday life, they'll face the harsh realities of a prison environment 24 hours a day—from cramped living conditions and constant surveillance to the mental strain of confinement and the social dynamics that come with it. As they navigate intense physical challenges, high-pressure mental tests, and strategic gameplay, they'll work toward one ultimate goal: escape.

Every decision matters. Every relationship has consequences. And only those who can outlast, outthink, outmaneuver—and endure—the competition will have a chance at victory.

**We're looking for people who:**
* Have larger-than-life personalities
* Are highly competitive and strategic
* Can handle demanding physical and mental challenges
* Can endure the stress, discipline, and psychological pressures of living in a prison environment 24/7
* Possess a **unique talent, skill set, or area of expertise **that could give them an edge in the game
* Thrive under pressure and adapt quickly to changing circumstances

**Apply now and prove you have the brains, grit, resilience, and determination to survive prison life, escape—and win $100,000.**

APPLY NOW: [https://prisonescape.castingcrane.com/](https://prisonescape.castingcrane.com/)

PAID CASTING: Female Lead/Co Star | Music Video | Toronto / GTA
Casting a female lead (playing age 19–27) for a cinematic pop/R&B music video filming in the GTA one day between Sept 26-Oct 5 (exact date TBD).

Concept: A darkly playful relationship visual centered around a chess game, exploring gaslighting, hypocrisy and double standards. The female character is confident and self-assured and genuinely believes she is being reasonable, even as the male lead becomes increasingly frustrated. Looking for someone who can communicate disbelief, defensiveness, irritation and “you’re overreacting” energy through subtle facial expressions and eye contact.

• Rate: $150 CAD flat

• Time: Approx. 3–4 hours

• Location: GTA, exact location TBD

• Union: Non-union

• Physicality: No kissing, sexual content or romantic physicality required.

Acting/on-camera experience is preferred but newer performers with strong camera presence are welcome.

To apply: DM me here or on IG @thelinkstrummer with your name, age/playing age, current photos, general GTA location, and any acting reel/on-camera footage if available. Thanks!

Jack has opened his eyes to a more exciting world and life, so he is ready to drop everything for her.

This is a paid role. Range for actors depending on role: $50-$200

UCCS DIGITAL FILMMAKING CAPSTONE FILM AUDITIONS

The UCCS Digital Filmmaking program has a new Fall semester section of our capstone course, and the three students in the class are gearing up for their capstone film auditions being held October 10 from 10:30am - 7pm on the UCCS campus.

I try to structure the auditions and the film shoots for our capstone course in a way that is as actor-friendly as possible:
* Auditions are held on UCCS campus on the weekends when there is free parking
* I have students hold auditions in groups of 3, so you can potentially audition for up to 3 films in one visit (you will be asked in the Calendly signup to note all of the films and roles you would like to audition for)
* Each film is only allowed one 12-hour shoot day between October 25 - November 15, so you can potentially act in multiple films with a minimal time commitment
* All filming locations will be in or very near to Colorado Springs

COPY OF FINAL FILM AND FOOTAGE

Students are required to use their OneDrive accounts to share a copy of the finished film AND all film footage with actors by the end of the semester (I enforce this by withholding the grade on their film if they don’t provide proof that they’ve shared everything with their actors). This is a great way to get footage for your reel.

HOW TO SIGN UP FOR AUDITIONS

The following link will take you to a OneDrive folder with the casting calls for all three films, and all casting calls will have the Calendly link to sign up for an audition time:

[[https://shorturl.at/gSyoH](https://shorturl.at/gSyoH)](https://shorturl.at/gSyoH?fbclid=IwcGRvZgFleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFsQ2R1NW0wdFp6bUdkOTlMc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHjuY9YZxtm8qLjm4QFUuopxeD9V_BguEOV_Mjp8muExGFiEG1U500cTvOXkY_aem_NtBgZU-ZD-UGMDvZkCxRHg)

* The production date and audition date is listed on each casting call, as are character breakdowns. Please make sure you are available on the production date and fit the requirements of the role you are auditioning for before signing up for a time. If you have questions about individual films (including whether or not they will accept virtual auditions), please reach out to the contact email on the casting call. If you are having trouble accessing the casting calls, please DM me and I’ll get back to you ASAP.

You can view UCCS capstone films from the past few years at this link:

[https://shorturl.at/mc1K1](https://shorturl.at/mc1K1)

Thank you everyone for supporting our student filmmakers!

✨ DOBRO MA WIELKĄ SIŁĘ — DZIEL SIĘ NIM RÓWNIEŻ POPRZEZ SZTUKĘ! ✨

Zapraszamy do udziału w II Ogólnopolskim Konkursie Sztuki „DOBRO FEST” — wydarzeniu, które łączy talent, twórczość i pozytywne emocje. 🎨🎶💃🎭

Sztuka potrafi inspirować, wspierać i przypominać o tym, co naprawdę ważne. Czasem jeden występ, jedna praca czy jedna melodia mogą wywołać uśmiech, dodać otuchy i zostawić po sobie coś dobrego. 💛

📅 Przyjmowanie zgłoszeń: od 22.09 do 06.10.

💻 Uczestnictwo odbywa się w formule zdalnej, dlatego możesz dołączyć z dowolnego miejsca — bez konieczności podróżowania.

Na uczestników czekają:

🌟 bez ograniczeń wiekowych;
🎤 wszystkie nominacje i gatunki;
📜 dyplomy i listy podziękowania;
🏅 medale;
🏆 puchary.

💛 Wyjątkowy koszt uczestnictwa — tylko 35 PLN!

„DOBRO FEST” to nie tylko konkurs, ale także możliwość pokazania swojej pasji, zdobycia nowego doświadczenia i dodania kolejnego osiągnięcia do artystycznego portfolio. ✨

Niech Twoja twórczość niesie dobrą energię, inspiruje innych i przypomina, że talent ma największą wartość wtedy, gdy potrafi poruszyć drugiego człowieka. ❤️

🌐 Szczegółowe informacje i warunki uczestnictwa:
2gagencja.com

Organizator — Ogólnopolska Agencja Sztuki 2G.

🌟 „DOBRO FEST” — twórz z sercem, dziel się talentem i zostawiaj po sobie dobro!

Von Berlin nach Bayreuth – und hier längst zuhause.

Die Idee, JEDERMANN nach Bayreuth zu holen, begleitete Sven Schenke von Anfang an mit großer Begeisterung. 2026 steht er nun erneut mit unserem Ensemble auf der Bühne – diesmal als Schuldknecht.

Eine Stadt. Eine Bühne. Viel Leidenschaft für Theater. 🎭

📍 Friedrichsforum Bayreuth
📅 5.–7. November 2026
🎟️ www.jedermann-theater.de

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 39/2026

AKTUELLE KINOSTARTS, EINE KULTBIENE WIRD 50 UND Ö FILMSCHWERPUNKT

Neben den neu startenden Filmen in unseren Kooperationskinos, dem Kinocomeback der Biene Maja, gibt es in dieser Sendung einen Schwerpunkt zum österreichischen Film.

Zu den vorzustellenden Filmen gibt es dazu jeweils ein Interview und zwar:

Gentle Monster (Alexander Glehr & Johanna Scherz)

Mit Ästen bis zum Himmel (Bettina Blickwede)

Die noch unbekannten Tage (Jola Wieczorek)

Musikalisch gibt es erneut ein Best of der beliebtesten Moviesongs der letzten Jahre.

Mittwoch 23.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

items.text:
🌌 CASTING CALL 🌌
left eddy stories are casting for a preview performance of ‘Beneath The Camouflage Tree’ on 5th Nov at Forest Arts Centre in New Milton. We recently had a well-received performance at White Bear Theatre (aka ‘South London’s New Writing Powerhouse’ - The Stage), and have been shortlisted for the Vault Creative Arts Playwrighting Award(!), so we’re excited to do another regional preview before our small scale tour launches in 2027…

For this preview, we are looking for a female and/or gender-queer actor, based in Hampshire/Dorset to play opposite Francesca McBride (Single White Female, Generation Z, Boarders) as either JACK, a quiet but observant Lance Corporal, or EVELYN, a fiesty and playful young woman disguised as Private Anthony Fielding. If you are available from 26th Oct-5th Nov and interested in applying, please complete the application form in our link.tree: linktr.ee/BeneathTheCamouflageTree

We are asking applicants to complete the short form and tape ONE of two scene options for the role they feel like the best fit for - please choose the scene you feel most comfortable and confident with! 💙 

We’re so excited to see what everyone brings to the table 😊 

🌌 DEADLINE TO APPLY: 5pm, Monday 28th Sept 🌌 
•
#casting #theatreaudition #lgbtq #actor #hampshirearts

It follows fictional characters Jack and Tony, inspired by a composite of many real women soldiers', against the backdrop of an observation post in WW1, examining the complexity of relationships, identity, and grief. We are interested in hearing from actors who identify as LGBTQ+ for this role, but are open to applications from anyone who feels they could be a good fit."

AUDITION: MÆND SØGES TIL MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig den sidste ekstra-audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere til store roller samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondatoer: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

I’m Dor, a photographer who recently moved to Berlin and I’m currently looking to connect with photography studios, model/talent agencies and creative teams.

My work focuses in portraits and event photography, with a strong focus on catching emotions and show them in an esthetic, artsy way which define my unique style. I shoot with both analog and digital photography 

I’m especially interested in joining a team where I can shoot regularly, work with models/talents and contribute to ongoing productions.

If you know a studio, agency, photographer or production company looking for a photographer, I’d love to hear from you.

Thanks!

items.text:
**PAID CASTING CALL - TV PILOT (Multiple characters)**

**Project:** "Deadly Chess Royale", a gothic steampunk Live Action Anime Thriller (yes, Live Action Anime like Netflix's One Piece Live Action Anime)
**Location: **New York City
**Showrunner, Producer, Director: **Tiger Lapis
**Production Dates:** Between Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027 (exact dates TBD)
**Union Status: **Open to Union and Non-Union actors, but this will be a SAG Union shoot (We will Taft-Hartley Non-Union actors)
**Compensation: **TBD based on Role (SAG Union Rate)

**About the Series:**
Two women geniuses battle in chess to choose who dies as one seeks revenge and the other fights to follow her heart in a futuristic gothic New York City.  One is Detective Julia Jeng, the genius detective and Master Strategist leading the white chess team.  The other is her former childhood friend, Officer Julia Cho, the Master Manipulator leading the black chess team. 
The series is like "Alice in Borderland" meets "The Queen's Gambit" and "Death Note". 

**Casting for the Following Characters:**

**1) Detective Julia Jeng, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their late 20s

Ethnicity: East Asian (will consider mixed-race East Asian)

Height: at least 5'4" or TALLER 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Character is like a beautiful Tomboy 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*Highly Preferred if you also have a deep, low voice 
*Actress needs to have a strong physical presence, and action-hero confidence with emotional vulnerability.

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Genius Detective Julia Jeng (leader of the White Chess Team) fights to stay true to who she wants to be in a world that tries to force her to be someone she's not.  A Master Strategist and a tough, strong woman who is intense, like an untouchable blade, she's also quirky, blunt, direct, sarcastic, and a bit of an oblivious idiot when it comes to romance.  Although her social skills are a bit lacking and she doesn't open up easily (nor does she like to be vulnerable), she's quite lonely, and has suffered major trauma when her family was destroyed.  Still, she tries her best to never give up.  A very passionate person who gives it her all, she is the one who fights with love in her heart.   Most importantly, this is a woman who must inspire the audience. This is someone who can do the impossible and believes she can do the impossible.  She doesn't conform to society, she doesn't fit in, but no one else is like her.  She'll go through an incredibly difficult journey in the show through deadly chess games she must play against her former childhood best friend to choose who dies, and is forced with morally-complicated choices as the world tries to force her to be someone she doesn't want to be. 
There is romantic tension between Detective Julia Jeng and lead male, Detective Kazuki Kamijo.
FYI this is NOT NCIS or that type of show.  This is a Gothic Steampunk Noir Thriller ala Tim Burton inspired style, similar to the tone, vibe, and world of Tim Burton's "Batman Returns".   And is very much a Live Action Anime, similar to how One Piece is a live action Anime.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 14-16 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**2) Detective Kazuki Kamijo, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their Late 20s or early 30s

Ethnicity: East Asian OR mixed-race East Asian

Height: at least 5'9" -  6'4" or taller 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Detective Kazuki Kamijo (on the White Chess Team) is the lead male character and the right-hand man of Detective Julia Jeng in the Deadly Chess Games she must play against her former childhood best friend, The Master Manipulator Officer Cho.  Kazuki is a strong, grounded character who is wise, sincere, deeply compassionate, has a great balance of strength with a soft side to him, a bit of dry humor, is incredibly smart, and the one who grounds the lead protagonist Detective Julia Jeng, his best friend whom he has worked together with before.  Whereas Officer Cho tries to seduce Julia Jeng into the darkness of revenge, Kazuki tries to keep Julia Jeng in the light. There is strong Romantic tension between him and Julia Jeng as well.  Actor must be able to deliver words of wisdom. This is a deep character. Kazuki is loyal to the New York Police Department and the top shooter on the force. He is also one of the best fighters on the White Chess Team, with incredible combat skills and abilities. There are also layers to Detective Kazuki Kamijo as this is a complex character.  There is more to this guy. 

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 8-10 days of filming for your role **(see below how to Submit)**

**3) Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (series regular)**
Age: Looks like in their early 20s or Younger 
Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Japanese)
Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 
*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you

Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (on the Black Chess Team). She is psychotic and the most volatile and mentally unstable character in the entire series. Also deemed the best and most dangerous fighter on the black chess team. Although she is in her 20s, she dresses like a young Japanese schoolgirl due to a traumatic event that left her frozen mentally in that time period. She uses her youthful looks to her advantage on her unsuspecting targets. She is the right-hand woman of the Master Manipulator, former police officer Cho, who leads the black chess team. A bit of Cho's pet, she is intensely loyal to Cho and no one else, which is why Cho is the only one who can control her.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 3-6 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**4) John Cho, the ARSONIST, Series Regular**
Age: Looks like in their 20s to early 30s 

Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Korean)

Willing to do action/fight scenes 
Added bonus if you have some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

John Cho, the ARSONIST (on the White Chess Team). He is the Korean bad boy of the series. Pretty much a total a**hole, and nearly all his teammates dislike him as he can't get along with anyone. Obsessed with fire, he is highly skilled when it comes to using fire as a weapon, understanding the inner mechanics of how it flows and works. He has a highly self-destructive personality and is an avid smoker, where most of the time you will see him with a cigarette in his mouth. (Note: Actor will NOT smoke real cigarettes) He is highly artistic though, known for his illegal graffiti art. No one wants to work with him. He says everything offensive to everyone around him. He does, however, has a bit of a chill uncaring personality, and doesn't talk much unless to offend someone. Most of the time, he looks like he doesn't give a f*** about anything. A bit of a nihilist, he hides his feelings behind a traumatic past.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 3-6 days of filming for your role **(see below how to Submit)**

**5) Raven Chan, the THIEF (series regular)**

Must have MARTIAL ARTS EXPERIENCE! 

*This role requires a lot of martial arts choreography and fight scenes. We are looking for someone who is a highly trained martial artist! If you have ROPE DART experience, it's an added plus! 

Raven Chan, the THIEF (on the Black Chess Team), is a notorious professional thief who is hired to steal artifacts, antiques, and paintings worth millions of dollars. He also has a string of successful bank robberies under his belt. His motto is, “Anything you ask, I’ll steal.” Oddly chauvinistic, a trickster, and even polite (when he’s not fighting). He is jokingly known as the “Hong Kong pop star” given his beautiful looks, and is recognized for his premature snow white hair that has been caused by a traumatic childhood event. Raven is an avid violin player, often carrying a violin case on his back. What others don’t realize is that in his violin case hides a dangerous martial arts weapon. He is in a romantic relationship with Em.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 4-7 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**>>> **✨**How to Submit (for above characters):**
Please email deadlychessroyale@gmail.com (NO Dm's):
**Subject Line: **"Casting Submission: [Character Name ] - [Your Name]"
* Headshot
* Resume
* Acting reel 
* Action/Fight Reel (if you have one, not required, but it helps!)
* Note if you have any martial arts background/experience, kickboxing, etc. (not required)
* Current Location 
* Social Media links (if you're on Social)
* Availability for November 1-January 1, 2026 (Expect around 8-16 days of filming + rehearsals, depending on your role)

**Submission Deadline:** September 29, 2026

Note: This is an Ensemble Cast of 14 main characters!  I only posted some key characters here, but there are 11 more series regular characters listed on Casting Network (different ethnicity, not all are Asian characters).   That should be posted soon -- I'm waiting for Casting Network to approve the post.  Keep an eye out for that and check there also!  It's called "Deadly Chess Royale - TV Pilot".

Szukamy tancerzy oraz osób dobrze czujących się w ruchu do udziału w teledysku zespołu WYDDMY.

📅 wstępnie: 2.10.2026

Szukamy tancerzy oraz osób dobrze czujących się w ruchu do udziału w teledysku zespołu WYDDMY.

Projekt będzie utrzymany w klimacie muzyki elektronicznej / drum & bass. Szukamy osób otwartych na nietypowy, dynamiczny i eksperymentalny ruch oraz pracę w grupie. Nie musisz być zawodowym tancerzem — najważniejsze są swoboda ruchu, energia i chęć udziału w projekcie.

Zdjęcia odbędą się w Warszawie lub okolicach Warszawy. Wstępnie planowany termin to 2 października, dokładna data i lokalizacja zostaną jeszcze potwierdzone.

W formularzu poprosimy m.in. o kilka informacji o doświadczeniu oraz twoje zdjęcia/filmy. 

Wybrane osoby otrzymają później więcej informacji dotyczących muzyki, choreografii, miejsca oraz organizacji zdjęć.

Projekt non-profit - pokrywamy ew. koszty transportu

🎬 **BEZAHLTER COMEDY-WERBEDREH: **

**Frau ca. 45–65 Jahre für diesen Freitag in Wien gesucht**

Für ein kurzes Social-Media-Werbevideo mit einem bekannten österreichischen Creator suchen wir kurzfristig eine sympathische, humorvolle Frau, die gerne vor der Kamera steht.

**Die Rolle:**
Du spielst überspitzt eine verliebte österreichische Urlauberin, die ihren jüngeren nordafrikanischen Urlaubspartner am Flughafen abholt. Der Clip ist eine klar erkennbare und humorvolle Parodie auf bekannte TV-Datingformate (Amore unter Palmen etc.).

**Drehdetails:**
📅 Freitag, 25. September
🕗 Start gegen 8/9 Uhr
⏱ Ca. 3–4 Stunden
📍 Wien und eine kurze Szene beim Flughafen
💶 Bezahlter Dreh – Vergütung inkludiert
🎥 Veröffentlichung als Social-Media-Werbevideo (mit Rechten zur Nutzung und Bewerbung)

Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich! Wichtig sind Humor, Natürlichkeit, Lockerheit vor der Kamera und die Bereitschaft, die verliebte Rolle etwas überspitzt zu spielen.

Bei Interesse bitte möglichst rasch eine kurze Nachricht mit Foto, Telefonnummer und, falls vorhanden, einem kurzen Video oder Social-Media-Profil schicken. 😊

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas Goersch

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

**🚨 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ**

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy. Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

**Co jest do zrobienia:**

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: **pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. **

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

**Wymagania:**

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

**Chcesz spróbować?**

Wyślij mi na DM swoją video wizytówkę, lub krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

**Zaprzyjaźnij się ze swoim ciałem i uwolnij emocje na warsztatach tanecznych!**

U nas profesjonalizm spotyka się z dbałością o dobrostan i poczuciem bezpieczeństwa uczestników.

Odwiedź stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie lub Czuła Fundacja. Możesz też odwiedzić naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/ 

Dowiedz się więcej o czułej i twórczej przestrzeni, którą dla Ciebie budujemy.

Poznaj prowadzącego grupę SQARE Kacper Mucha. Kacper jest profesjonalnym tancerzem i choreografem. Ale nie zapomniał o tym, co dawał mu taniec w dzieciństwie. Był sposobem na rozładowanie energii i emocji z całego dnia.

"Pracuję z uczestnikami nad większym poczuciem własnej wartości i lepszym osadzeniem w swoim ciele. Wzmacniamy je i rozwijamy koordynację ruchową. Dzięki temu zaprzyjaźniamy się ze swoim ciałem i emocjami. Obserwujeny siebie i swoje reakcje. Poznajemy sami siebie. Chcę, żeby „Square” było dla Was bezpiecznym miejscem, w którym uczycie się zaufania do siebie i świata, zglębiając profesjonalne techniki taneczne".

Jeżeli chcesz poszukać tańca w sobie i siebie w tańcu, dać sobie przestrzeń na rozwój i po prostu się poruszać — przyjdź do nas!

Grupa SQUARE startuje już w najbliższy poniedziałek 21 września o 18.00 na ul. Marymonckiej 34!

Poniższe zdjęcie jest z uroczystej Gali Zakończenia Sezonu Artystycznego, którą co roku organizujemy w naszej Fundacji. Na Gali prezentują się wszyscy chętni uczestnicy naszych zajęć. Wspieramy się wzajemnie i tworzymy pełne zaufania więzi. Dołącz do naszej społeczności!

Bądź z nami w najbliższy poniedziałek! Zapraszamy młodzież I dorosłych.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej - napisz do nas na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl
